SELECT
  c.id,
  c.nombre_comercial,
  c.localidad,
  c.provincia,
  c.direccion,
  c.telefono,
  c.google_cid,
  COALESCE(c.google_place_id, '') AS google_place_id
FROM clientes.clientes c
WHERE c.estado = 'activo'
  AND (
    c.google_cid IS NULL
    OR c.google_cid = ''
    OR TRIM(c.google_place_id) = ''
    OR c.google_place_id IS NULL
  )
LIMIT 1000

UPDATE clientes.clientes
SET
  google_cid = '{{ $json.bestCandidate.place_id }}',
  google_place_id = 'cid:' || '{{ $json.bestCandidate.place_id }}',
  gmaps_nombre = '{{ $json.bestCandidate.name }}',
  gmaps_rating = {{ $json.bestCandidate.rating != null ? $json.bestCandidate.rating : 'NULL' }},
  gmaps_last_updated = NOW(),
  gmaps_pendiente_validar = false
WHERE id = {{ $json.cliente.id }}
